findings.claim: README says v2 has 7 tools, dropping ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade. PRD and TECH-SPEC say v2 has 9 tools and keep ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade as tools (Q3b, accepted decision).
findings.evidence: docs/v2/README.md:101 "7 tools: `ctx_execute` (absorbs `execute_file`), `ctx_batch`, `ctx_index` (absorbs `fetch_and_index`), `ctx_search`, `ctx_resume`, `ctx_stats`, `ctx_purge`." -- this list has no ctx_doctor and no ctx_upgrade. Compare PRD-v2.md:289 "Tools (replaces G4 'doctor/upgrade removed'): 9 tools -- ctx_execute, ctx_batch, ctx_index, ctx_search, ctx_resume, ctx_stats, ctx_doctor, ctx_upgrade, ctx_purge." and TECH-SPEC.md:409 "Q3b `ctx_doctor` and `ctx_upgrade` stay as tools, rebuilt for v2 (section 3.11) [D]" and TECH-SPEC.md:215 "3.11 `ctx_doctor` and `ctx_upgrade` (kept, rebuilt for v2) [D 2026-10-14]".
findings.fix: Edit README.md:101 to list 9 tools and add ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade back, matching PRD section 17 and TECH-SPEC Q3b.
findings.archaeology: git log --oneline --all -S'ctx_doctor' in v1 history (cm-main) shows ctx_doctor has existed since early v1 (4d2c771e, the commit that added the ctx_ tool prefix) through many fixes, including a dedicated regression test for resource cleanup (c71c2299, #247/#268). v1 users rely on ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade for install health checks and the v1-to-v2 upgrade path itself (ADR-0011, ADR-0017 R3: install v2, run /ctx-upgrade, then npm uninstall). Dropping these tools (as README implies) would break the only documented upgrade path and is a regression against the owner's explicit v1-retention rule (ADR-0017 'v1 users must not leave'). REGRESSION_RISK: high -- the upgrade flow in ADR-0017 R3 depends on ctx_upgrade existing as a tool. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: README must not drop ctx_doctor/ctx_upgrade; any future removal needs its own ADR decision, not a silent README miscount.

findings.evidence: DECISIONS-r3.md:24 "Q18 | Issue debug data: only secrets are stripped ... This replaces ADR-0014's 'no path text' rule ... | ADR-0014, agent-issue-intake/" and DECISIONS-r3.md:29 "The ADRs, the PRD and the TECH-SPEC have not been edited yet." docs/v2/adr/0014-issue-forms-and-debug-report.md still needs verification; per the decisions doc itself this file is listed as not yet updated.

findings.archaeology: Not applicable -- this is a doc-sync gap flagged by the decisions file itself, not a behavior change needing v1 history.
